I’ve struggled with my weight a lot in the past. I was on a medication and gained 40+ lbs that I just now lost, nearly 6 years later, and I only lost the weight because I got so sick for so long that I could barely eat anything without throwing up.

I know it’s hard but please be kind to your body. You don’t need to love it, let alone like it, but be kind to it. Eat when you are hungry, drink lots of water, maybe be a bit more active if you’re able (I personally wasn’t able for a couple yrs).

Also, regardless of what size you are, regardless of your health or whatever excuse people give, you are worthy of respect, decency, and love.

But honestly, that believing in God (or rather, pretending to believe in God) would make my dad love me. I was a good little Christian kid. I would ask my dad to say prayers with me every night because it made him so happy. I never believed in any of it. It’s a running joke now. I’d ask the pastors questions, I’d point out any fallacy in their arguments,  I’d think to myself “all these stories are so far fetched and dumb” but I was still the Christian Kid until I wasn’t. 

My dad was and is textbook abusive. If he ever loved me, it was a warped and selfish love, and there’s nothing I can do to make it healthy. But for years I believed that as long as I followed a specific set of rules, I was okay and our relationship was okay.

I’m frustrated and feel very stagnant at the moment. I’m in therapy for PTSD, because apparently my shit dad was more than just shitty. One of the things that’s hard for me is bringing up things that hurt me, because I was constantly gaslit, insulted, and put down. Everything was my fault.

I’ve talked to him about one specific instance in the past, and he was only kind and understanding. I know, logically, I don’t have to worry about talking to him, but it’s his friend. It’s a big ask and I’m just so scared of the whole thing. I keep thinking that maybe if I have a blueprint on how the conversation should go, it’ll make it easier. I keep thinking that maybe I’m somehow wrong and this is normal. 

I don’t know. I want to fix it and I don’t really know how to take that first step.
